tei:div.tei:p: A song of ascents. I lift my eyes to the mountains— from where will my help come? My help [comes] from Adonoy, Maker of heaven and earth. He will not let your foot slip, He will not slumber—your Guardian. Behold—He does not slumber nor does He sleep—the Guardian of Israel. Adonoy is your guardian, Adonoy is your shelter at your right hand. By day the sun will not smite you, nor the moon at night. Adonoy will guard you from all evil, He will preserve your soul, Adonoy will guard your going and coming from now and forever.
